48.original: At the Battle of Carteneau, as fire rained down from the heavens...

49.original: Archon Louisoix invoked the power of the Keeper and sent his fellow heroes into an aetherial rift, beyond the reach of the devastation.

50.original: Five years since that fateful day, since the Seventh Umbral Era changed the world forever, the time is come for the heroes to return.

51.original: Deep in the sunbaked south, surrounded by the shifting sands of an endless desert, she rises.

52.original: A solitary rose amidst the dust and rock. A symbol of defiance. Her name: Ul'dah.

53.original: Even with the coming of the Seventh Umbral Era, hope springs eternal for the mongers and merchants who vie for lost fortunes in this bustling oasis.

54.original: As the Twin Faces of Nald'thal maintain Their vigil over all<hex:02100103>that has been and shall be, the present proffers a brave soul...

55.original: ...One whose arrival could mark the beginning of a new era of prosperity for the realm.

56.original: May the Traders nurture our fortunes as They kindle the flames which burn within us all.

57.original: For by fire are we reborn.
